name: Question 10
problem: Which of the following matrices has a rank of $4?$
worked_solution:
First, notice that a matrix of rank $4$ must have at least $4$ columns and at least $4$ rows. 
So, we disregard the following matrices:

- $A$ since it has only $3$ columns (and only $3$ rows).

- $C$ since it has only $3$ columns.

- $D$ since it has only $3$ rows.

Also, the matrix must have $4$ pivot columns. As we can see, the matrix $E$ has exactly $4$ pivot columns, while the matrix $B$ has only $2$ pivot columns. So, $\text{rank}(E)=4$ and $\text{rank}(B)=2.$

Therefore, the correct answer is the matrix $E.$

Question 10
?

Which of the following matrices has a rank of 4?

a
D=[1−10−22021−1000301]
b
E=[3−12420113−200−21200033]
c
B=[−1023010−100000000]
d
A=[−43−102−300−2]
e
C=[12−101−2001000]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, notice that a matrix of rank 4 must have at least 4 columns and at least 4 rows. So, we disregard the following matrices:

  • A since it has only 3 columns (and only 3 rows).

  • C since it has only 3 columns.

  • D since it has only 3 rows.

Also, the matrix must have 4 pivot columns. As we can see, the matrix E has exactly 4 pivot columns, while the matrix B has only 2 pivot columns. So, rank(E)=4 and rank(B)=2.

Therefore, the correct answer is the matrix E.
